editorial:
Imagine you are traveling through the quiet English countryside and stumble into a nightmare where the dead just won't stay buried. You get to follow a detective who is trying to solve a string of weird murders, but he quickly finds himself blaming the wrong people. The whole vibe is a mix of a police mystery and a monster movie. It feels like a slow burn at first, but once the chaos starts, you will be glued to your seat watching the madness unfold in this foggy, creepy town.

What really works here is the weird science twist involving a machine meant to kill bugs that accidentally wakes up corpses. While some of the acting feels a bit stiff, the gore and the suspense make up for it. It is a great pick if you love old-school zombie flicks that take their time building tension. If you can, try to grab the 4K Blu-ray for your physical collection to see the practical effects in the best quality, or just look for it to rent on Apple TV for a quick movie night with friends.
endingExplained: Everything falls apart when the sonic machine goes out of control and wakes up way too many dead bodies. The town turns into a war zone as zombies swarm the streets. The main characters try to fight their way out, but the movie ends on a bleak note. Most of the survivors are overwhelmed by the undead horde, showing that once the science experiment went wrong, there was no way to stop the spread.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves old school zombie movies and weird science plots.
